applies_why: The judge text does not count a verse as an unanswered witness toward a broken link; it says the challenged limb was dropped and no live link remains.
quote: C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict
rule_words: A verse on a side's 'cited in' line counts as an unanswered witness only when the judge quotes the sentence of the earlier round that pressed it against that link or a listed premise and names that round; a verse cited there but not pressed against the link does not count. A verse the judge counts toward a broken link is counted this way. A verse the judge says was answered is not counted.
why: Because the verse is not counted toward a broken link, the quote-and-name requirement for an unanswered witness is not triggered.
